name: mycrew-specialists
description: Layer 3/6 — the specialists, called down into the work when a piece of it needs a trade of its own. Not a stage and not a watch: a lead dispatches one exactly as it dispatches a worker, and gets back the same four fields. The designer is the first, and it ships its whole trade with it — visual-language for what a look must be and the machine-defaults it must not fall into, interface-writing for the words on the surface, design-sync for publishing the component library to Claude Design out of the code and never back into it. It decides the look by building it, founding a visual language where none exists and extending one where it does, and it never leaves a mockup behind.
